cases.scenario: Run a RebirthUO issue workflow without an exact repository declared by applicable AGENTS.md.
cases.must_require: the exact repository identity from applicable AGENTS.md

cases.scenario: Run a new issue workflow where neither the request nor project instructions require a template.
cases.must_preserve: the governed fallback issue format without provider template access

cases.scenario: Run a template-backed workflow with verified template labels and a justified intake label selection.
cases.must_verify: the workflow carries label evidence but does not independently select or mutate labels

cases.scenario: Deliver a researched READY issue after a push and pull-request creation.
cases.must_verify: the current issue revision, selected/applied label evidence, remote SHA, and pull-request read-back

cases.scenario: Return a workflow result for a blocked or delivered issue workflow.
